_provenance.note: LLM reading of the lens token tables; not a measurement

axes.label: AM/PM clock-time suffixes ↔ duration/elapsed-time words
axes.rationale: Real-logit correlation clearly separates ' AM', ' PM', 'pm', ' noon' (negative) from ' hours', ' past', ' after', ' minutes', ' hrs' (positive), and the Jacobian positive end adds ' clock', ' years', ' centuries'. The logit and tuned lenses are mostly noise.

axes.label: duration/'past' continuations ↔ am/pm time-of-day markers
axes.rationale: Real-logit puts 'pm', ' am', ' PM', ' noon' positive and ' hours', ' after', ' past', ' hrs' negative. The logit and tuned lenses agree, with 'am' and 'AM' topping their positive lists. The Jacobian negative end shows ' hours', 'Hours', ' часа'.

axes.label: PM/'past' continuations ↔ hour/noon/midnight units
axes.rationale: Real-logit positive is ' hour', ' noon', ' hr', 'am', and its negative is ' PM', 'pm', ' after', ' past'. The Jacobian positive end has ' midnight', ' hour', ' HOUR', and the logit and tuned lenses also show ' midnight' and '刻'. The negative-end lens tokens are fragments ('teenth', 'th').
